completion_scope: Bounded country research and recovery pass complete. Four actual book searches, two selected and two reserves; ten substantial selected target unmet by eight. This is research, not production integration or a national service-availability verdict.

market.summary: Bilingual state-university and research-library market, alongside national/legal-deposit, municipal/associative and cultural libraries. Four actual PMB book searches were observed: UCAC and UPAC selected; IIA and GPE program library retained as reserves. The broader collection landscape is substantial even where current public endpoints or holdings are not verified.
market.platform_strategy: PMB is the strongest evidenced cross-institution family: named historical university implementations, 2023 MINESUP training, and four current native POST title/GET detail successes across several templates. Treat existing PMB code as a deployment-specific candidate requiring adaptation. SIL provides a sourced Koha candidate, but its unresolved preflight prevented a book query. No national physical-book union endpoint verified; electronic-resource/repository networks remain distinct.
